tagline: A space where you don't have to mask
intro: AUNSA is a supportive and welcoming community for neurodivergent students at the University of Auckland, where students can connect with others, share experiences and feel a sense of belonging. It's a space where you don't have to mask.
draftBanner: Draft preview: events, team and links are placeholders.
contactNote: We don't have a clubroom (yet!), so event locations go up on our Instagram and Events page. A DM or email is the quickest way to reach us.
